title: Mini PIzza
summary: Here's how to make easy mini pizzas with all your favorite toppings. These little pizzas are perfect for a family dinner, kid's snack, or party!
ingredients: 12 naan dippers, or any pizza dough or crust of choice
steps: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Place pizza crust on a lined baking tray. If using pizza dough, roll it out and cut into small circles using a small round cookie cutter or the rim of a cup.
Top with pizza sauce and cheese.Add the toppings, pressing gently in, and bake until cheese has melted and the crust is lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes.
